main.description: Mint a deterministic organization DID under social-contract.etzhayyim.com from an existing vertex_legal_entity row. Hash input: country_alpha3 + national_id + name_normalized + incorporated_date (blake3 12-char prefix). Idempotent: same input → same DID.

legalEntityVertexId.description: vertex_id of the source row in vertex_legal_entity

projectRow.description: Also write vertex_contracts_organization projection row (default true)

inserted.description: True if a new projection row was inserted, false if it already existed
